К явно названной будущей границе результат будет достигнут. Форма: will have + V3. Основной ответ: will have processed. Также принимается: will process.
Обещание, решение или прогноз на будущее. Форма: will + V1. Основной ответ: will continue.

answer_text: This quarter the support team has resolved 840 tickets so far. Last month it reduced its response time by twelve per cent. It has been testing a triage system since early September and the trial is not over. The system assigns urgent cases automatically whenever they arrive. Right now analysts are comparing its results with the old process. Before the trial began, managers had been waiting for a replacement system for two years. By the board's review next December, the team will have processed enough cases for a reliable comparison. The director promises analysts will continue monitoring results afterwards.
